result.summary: Replaces usages of `EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER` with `AddCoin` and `SpendCoin` in unit test fixtures for the coin cache. It retains direct testing of `EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER` in dedicated fuzz, simulation, and duplicate-insertion tests.
result.problem: Several coin cache unit test fixtures (flush, reset, overlay) set up coins using `EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER`, an internal method reserved for AssumeUTXO snapshot loading, coupling routine test setups to snapshot-specific bypass logic.
evidence: PR description notes that fixtures use `EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER` just to set up coins despite it being reserved for snapshot loading, and cites a reviewer suggestion in #35295
Extracted as an independent cleanup from #36598, which demonstrates removing AssumeUTXO
result.card: This PR updates coin-cache test fixtures to set up coins using AddCoin and SpendCoin rather than the snapshot-loading bypass EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER. The change decouples standard unit tests from snapshot-specific insertion internals, following a suggestion in PR #35295 and unblocking cleanup in #36598 while preserving targeted test coverage of the bypass method. It only affects test code.

risk.why: Touches only unit test fixture setup for coins cache tests; errors would cause test failures.
